coverage: legacy single-value and new grouped profile fields, safe internal wikilinks and bounded input
inline separators, lines and bullets in HTML, wikitext and installation checker
nine independent placements, top-only behavior and hidden component fallbacks
name size and profile alignment in shared preview and dashboard renderers
DST, fractional UTC offsets, day rollover and parts-based Intl fallback
one existing minute timer, no additional network for clock updates
cold, cached, progress and storage updates with retained verified creation proof
same-owner headers, copied foreign header cleanup and explicit unavailable evidence
complete exports, counter fragments and local editor duplicate guard
installer configuration, packaging manifests, destination and copy/download controls

checks: timezone change to UTC and back
complete profile export in local editor
preserved existing profile text and duplicate prevention

css.method: Actual local run of Wikimedia CSS parser, StylePropertySanitizer and selector grammar with the TemplateStyles rule construction used by this stylesheet. No site-specific Wikimedia hooks are loaded. Existing dependencies were read locally, fetch was blocked, no wiki was opened.

limitations: Synthetic local data only. No public APIs or real Commons photos were used in browser checks.
Native Firefox and Safari were not rerun for this candidate.
Local clock uses the device clock. Public saved markup carries its capture date and time.
